subject.identity: same ordinary adult throughout the video
subject.appearance: natural face, simple everyday clothing, restrained expression
subject.expression: calm self-reflection, no crying, no dramatic pain

location.primary_space: subway car, platform, reflective window, moving city lights
spatial_rules: all shots should feel like the same visual world
use different angles within the same location family
reuse recurring objects as visual anchors
avoid sudden jumps to unrelated locations

lighting.main_source: soft train interior light and passing city reflections
lighting.brightness: visible details, gentle contrast, no crushed black

palette.base: blue gray, muted steel, soft skin tones
palette.rule: keep color and contrast consistent across all shots
